_comment: Edit this file to change the featured twins on the landing page. Put real photos in public/images/twins/ and point the 'photos' paths at them.
headline: Two of a kind, looking for two of a kind.
subhead: Meet our featured twins. If you and your twin want to go on a double date with them, build your joint profile and apply.

prompts.prompt: The way to win me over is
prompts.answer: A perfectly timed pun and a willingness to split dessert. (I'll still take the bigger half.)

prompts.prompt: My twin would describe me as
prompts.answer: The planner. I've already picked the restaurant, the backup restaurant, and the after-dinner spot.
You laugh at yourself, you're kind to servers, and you get along with your sibling.
Being 4 minutes older and never letting anyone forget it.
Night-shift sunrises, the first sip of iced coffee, and karaoke with zero shame.
You can keep up with a twin-telepathy trivia round. We're undefeated.

sharedPrompts.answer: Tacos, a dive bar with a good jukebox, and a competitive round of mini golf. Losers buy the next round.
We once switched places for a whole day of high school and our own mom didn't notice until dinner.
